test_file_by_name: test the gRPC reflection servicer to resolve a .proto file by its filename
test_file_by_symbol: test the gRPC reflection servicer to resolve a file containing a given protobuf symbol name
test_file_containing_extension: test the gRPC reflection servicer to find a file by containing type and extension number
test_extension_numbers_of_type: test the gRPC reflection servicer to list all extension numbers for a given protobuf type
test_list_services: test the gRPC reflection servicer to list all registered service names on the server
